TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.TITLE: AI Agent Campaigns
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.DESCRIPTION: Launch an AI Agent over a group of contacts and track each campaign's progress.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.REFRESH_ERROR: The table could not be refreshed.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EMPTY_HINT: Create one with the “Add campaign” button or bulk-assign an AI Agent from Contacts.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search by name, AI Agent or channel…
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.DELETE_CONFIRM: Its active follow-ups will be cancelled (they stop sending) and the rest will stay unlinked under “All”. Delete campaign

MODE_HINT.batch: A segment or label was chosen: when started, the contacts it has at that moment are enrolled at once (up to 100).
MODE_HINT.continuous: No fixed list: your automations fill it with the “Add to campaign” action while it is open.

TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.CONTINUOUS_CREATED: Campaign "{name}" created. To receive contacts, create an automation that uses it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.LAUNCH_CONFIRM: Batch campaigns enroll the contacts the segment or label has right now and start sending; continuous ones start receiving contacts from automations. Start the campaign
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SAVED_HINT: Campaign saved. Nothing is sent until you press «Start».
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SAVED_BANNER: Saved: it does not enroll anyone or send messages until you start it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_SUCCESS: Changes saved. It stays Saved until you start it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_ERROR: The campaign could not be opened for editing.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_ONLY_SAVED: Only a Saved campaign can be edited: this one has already started.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.PAUSED_BANNER: Paused automatically: WhatsApp rejected a message because of a configuration problem, so the rest would fail too. Reason: {reason}
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.PAUSED_BANNER_HINT: Fix the problem (template, payment or WhatsApp account in Meta) and resume the campaign: paused follow-ups resend the attempt that failed.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.RESUME_SUCCESS: Campaign resumed: {count} follow-ups send again in a minute.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.RESUME_ERROR: The campaign could not be resumed.

FILTER_DESC.intent_paused_rule: Paused by a keyword rule (e.g. #pause) and still paused. They can be resumed.
FILTER_DESC.intent_cancelled_rule: Permanently cancelled by a keyword rule (e.g. #cancel).
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_pending: With their next message scheduled. They may have already received earlier attempts; they stay here until the next one is sent.
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_completed_replied: Exhausted attempts and got a reply.
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_failed: The follow-up could not run. Hover the ℹ️ on the status to see the exact cause.
FILTER_DESC.del_delivered: The channel confirmed the last message reached the contact (or was already read).
FILTER_DESC.del_sent: WhatsApp accepted the message but hasn't confirmed it reached the contact yet.
FILTER_DESC.del_unconfirmed: WhatsApp accepted the message over 24 h ago and never confirmed delivery. It is not resent: if it did arrive, the contact would get it twice.
FILTER_DESC.del_retrying: WhatsApp rejected the message for a temporary reason (rate limit or Meta failure); the same attempt is resent automatically.
FILTER_DESC.del_failed: The channel couldn't deliver the last message (invalid number, block, or other rejection).
FILTER_DESC.p_replied: Replied at least once (the AI read their reply).
FILTER_DESC.p_interested: Showed interest: the AI saw it in their reply (price, info, appointment or call) or an agent keyword marked it. Includes those already handed off.
FILTER_DESC.p_appointment: Booked an appointment (calendar or an agent keyword, e.g. #agendado).
FILTER_DESC.p_handed_off: Interested prospects already handed off to a salesperson.
FILTER_DESC.p_objective_met: The follow-up goal was met (or the seller already attended them); sending stops.
FILTER_DESC.p_not_now: Interested, but not now: written to once more after 30 days.
FILTER_DESC.p_not_interested: Said they're not interested; no more messages.
FILTER_DESC.p_wrong_person: Not the right person; no more messages.
FILTER_DESC.p_opted_out: Asked not to be contacted (email link, reply or an agent).
FILTER_DESC.p_bounced: Their email does not exist or does not accept mail: the follow-up stopped.
FILTER_DESC.p_no_reply: Used up their touches without replying at all.
FILTER_DESC.p_hot: Prospects with 60 points or more: the closest to your ideal customer and the most interested.

FAILURE.WINDOW_CLOSED: WhatsApp 24h window closed and no template configured: could not send.
FAILURE.SEND_FAILED: Could not send the message: the channel rejected the send or the conversation could not be created/found.
FAILURE.TEMPLATE_PARAMS: The template requires parameters that could not be resolved.
FAILURE.UNKNOWN: Execution error with no recorded detail.

HANDOFF_SETTINGS.TITLE: 🤝 Interested prospects hand-off
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.DESC: What happens when a prospect says they are interested. Applies to the next interested prospects.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.HOW_1: When a prospect says they are interested, their conversation goes straight to the Opportunities column you choose. Without a board, hand-off is only through the “Hand off” button.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.HOW_2: It is assigned to the conversation’s seller (if none, to whoever created the campaign) and they get a notification with their deadline.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.HOW_3: Deadline: if within those business hours nobody writes to the customer or moves their card, the seller gets a reminder. Empty = no deadline.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.HOW_4: Escalate: if that time passes and it is still unattended, administrators are notified. Empty = no escalation. Business hours = the inbox working hours; without them, Monday to Friday.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.HOW_5: When the seller writes to the customer or moves their card, the AI Agent stops replying in that conversation.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.SAVED: Hand-off saved. It applies to the next interested prospects.

SUBJECT_TEST.TITLE: 🔤 Subject test
SUBJECT_TEST.STATUS_WAITING: Half get subject A and half get B. Not enough data yet: the leader is shown once each has at least {min} contacted.
SUBJECT_TEST.STATUS_LEADER: Subject {letter} is winning. When you are sure, keep it and every new prospect gets it.
SUBJECT_TEST.STATUS_WINNER: You kept subject {letter}: every new prospect gets it. The comparison stays as it was.
SUBJECT_TEST.CHOSEN: Done: new prospects get that subject.

SCORING.TITLE: 🎯 Scoring
SCORING.DESC: How much each prospect looks like your ideal customer and how much interest they showed, 0 to 100.
SCORING.HOW_1: Score = Profile (up to 50) + Interest (up to 50). The suggested points can be changed.
SCORING.HOW_2: Profile: tell it which labels or attribute value your ideal customer has. Without a rule that criterion is 0; “Talks to the decision maker” without a rule is inferred by the AI from their replies.
SCORING.HOW_3: Interest: comes only from what the prospect replies and their appointments. It is recalculated with each reply and once a day.
SCORING.HOW_4: For now it only sorts and marks “🔥 Hot” prospects (60 or more); it hands nothing to sellers. With a few weeks of data, the points get tuned.
SCORING.PROFILE: Profile (do they look like my ideal customer?)
SCORING.SAVED: Scoring saved. Prospects are recalculated in a few seconds.
SCORING.COPIED: Copied. Review and save if you want to adjust something.
SCORING.SUMMARY_NO_RULES: No Profile rules: only Interest counts

TRACKING_CAMPAIGN_DETAIL.HAND_OFF_DONE: Handed off. Take it from the conversation.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGN_DETAIL.HAND_OFF_ERROR: Couldn't hand off. Please try again.

ENTRIES.EMPTY: Nobody has been enrolled yet. In a continuous campaign, contacts arrive through the "Add to campaign" automation action.

REASON.active_tracking: already has an active AI Agent
